status: frozen before any v2 feature extraction or model fitting; changes only via reanalysis/protocol_amendments.md

question.primary: Can a ternary classifier (no_mosquito / other_mosquito / aedes_aegypti) trained on wingbeat audio recognise Aedes aegypti in recordings from environments (lab+device or recording day) never seen in training?
question.secondary: Does performance transfer across corpora (Dryad/Abuzz <-> HumBug) and to never-used external corpora (MosquitoSong, UFRGS)?

excluded.torres_2025: no raw audio (precomputed mel tensors only), 100% Aedes: label = source

data.unit_of_independence: cluster (see build_manifest.py docstring); every split is by cluster; files are only the unit of prediction

frontend.decode: soundfile, ffmpeg fallback for m4a/mp4; mono mean
frontend.bandpass_filter: Butterworth order 4, sosfiltfilt over whole file
frontend.short_file_rule: files with 0.95 <= duration < 1.0 s are reflect-padded to 1.0 s; shorter files are dropped and counted
frontend.window_validity: reject window if RMS < 1e-4 of full scale (before gain normalisation) or > 1% of samples with |x| >= 0.999; identical rule for every class and source
frontend.window_selection: if more valid windows than the cap, take 30 evenly spaced valid windows (deterministic)
frontend.gain_normalisation: each window scaled to unit RMS after band-pass
frontend.tabular_features: per-band mean and std of log-mel over time (80) + wingbeat descriptors from a 1 s FFT (f0 by harmonic sum over 150-1000 Hz, log harmonic ratios h2/h1 h3/h1 h4/h1, spectral centroid, bandwidth, flatness, energy fraction below 1 kHz)

models.M0_majority: predicts the training-majority class; scores = training class priors

M3_cnn.blocks: 3 x (conv3x3, BatchNorm, ReLU, maxpool2) with 16/32/64 channels
M3_cnn.head: global average pool, dropout 0.3, linear
M3_cnn.early_stopping: patience 6 on inner-validation file-level class-balanced log loss

models.M4_wingbeat_logistic: M1 restricted to the 9 wingbeat descriptors (biologically motivated baseline)
models.sample_weights: each file has total weight 1 across its windows; classes rescaled to equal total weight in the training set
models.aggregation: file score = softmax(mean over windows of log-probabilities)
models.decision_rule: argmax only; no threshold tuning anywhere

splits.outer: StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=20261020), y=target, groups=cluster, on development files
splits.inner: StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=3, shuffle=True, random_state=20261021) inside each outer-training set; hyper-parameters by mean inner file-level balanced accuracy; CNN epochs from inner fold 0
splits.requirement: every outer test fold contains at least one Aedes cluster; asserted

evaluations.E1_grouped_cv: 5-fold cluster-grouped CV on all development sources (primary)
evaluations.E2_cross_corpus: train on Dryad + pete_noise + esc50, test on HumBug; train on HumBug + pete_noise + esc50, test on Dryad mosquitoes (Dryad has no in-situ noise: metrics restricted to other vs Aedes); hyper-parameters by inner grouped CV on the training corpus (primary)
evaluations.E3_external: models refit on the whole development set (hyper-parameters by grouped 3-fold CV), evaluated once on MosquitoSong and UFRGS (other vs Aedes; no noise class present)
evaluations.S1_native_rate: E1 OOF predictions stratified by native sample rate (no refit)
evaluations.S2_in_situ_noise_only: E1 repeated without pete_noise and esc50 (noise = HumBug background only)
evaluations.S3_matched_setting: HumBug Tanzania|Ifakara|tascam|cup only, other vs Aedes, grouped by recording day (same device and setup for both classes)
evaluations.P_shortcut_probes: grouped-CV balanced accuracy of M1/M2 on tabular features for (a) dryad vs humbug among mosquito files, (b) native 8 kHz vs 44.1 kHz among Dryad other-mosquito files; computed before E1-E3

metrics.uncertainty: cluster bootstrap, 2000 resamples of clusters with replacement within each class stratum, percentile 95% CI; undefined replicates counted and reported
metrics.model_comparison: paired cluster bootstrap of differences (balanced accuracy, Aedes AUROC) vs M0 and between models
baselines: chance balanced accuracy = 1/3 (3 classes) or 1/2 (2 classes)

interpretation_rules_declared_in_advance.evidence_of_aedes_recognition_in_new_env: E1 and E2 Aedes AUROC 95% CI lower bound > 0.5 AND balanced-accuracy CI lower bound above chance
interpretation_rules_declared_in_advance.shortcut_warning: probe balanced accuracy > 0.8 means source/device remains decodable from the v2 features and any cross-source claim must be qualified
interpretation_rules_declared_in_advance.no_field_claim: no result here is a field validation; external corpora are laboratory recordings
